notes.title: DEVLOG 3. Live mode. Active Careers and Characters updates
notes.content:
Hey neighbors, Vivers, and all you enthusiasts!

We've got some updates about our ongoing development. As you know, we're hard at work on the life mode and are eager to share some news with you.

Let's dive deeper into our town and explore how everything is organized:

We aim to make it feel like you're living in a cozy little town where everyone helps out, and the town thrives thanks to its residents. We're planning to fill it with green spaces to create a tranquil retreat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42299119/67f9a675a4b4f61498718959b7f813c03990f3c5.gif[/img]

Here’s what we’re setting up: active careers that allow you to collaborate with others in town. We're starting with four types:

1. Culinary: You could open a quaint café right on your property or run a fine dining restaurant.
2. Farming: Grow veggies on your roof or even print meat right in your kitchen! Use what you produce to whip up delicious meals or sell them to your neighbors and local cafes.
3. Engineering: The town needs someone to fix cars and machines, invent new gadgets for gardens and cafes, or simply enjoy experimenting.
4. Music: Start a band with friends and play at local venues or just jam in your backyard.

Sure, you can try doing all these careers solo with some npc’s to help out, but trust us, it’s way more fun with real friends.

Also, meet our first townies: Adam and Eve,  Don’t worry, they're just our test dummies, not the ones from the garden!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42299119/1124db2c94c6c899cac0926ddef5866e26971d89.png[/img]

We've been tinkering away behind the scenes, enhancing our character textures and fine-tuning their skin and hair shaders to give our Vivas an extra touch of natural charm. It was quite the challenge, trying to upgrade our characters while maintaining their core structure – same bones, same body mesh.

We're excited about how it turned out and can’t wait to hear what you think!

notes.title: DREAM HOUSE IS OUT NOW! BUILD TOGETHER!
notes.content:
Dream House serves as a prologue, showcasing the Build Mode of Vivaland, and it is a free-to-play game. Up to eight players can claim lots in the town of Vivaland and can build houses in single-player mode or visit their friend’s lot and build together.  
[previewyoutube=LnDTQwFq358;full][/previewyoutube]
🛋[b]Furniture:[/b]
 [list]
[*] Seven distinct styles of furniture: Basic, Classical, Industrial, Bohemian, Gothic, Minimalist, and Country.
[*]  830+ furniture items.
[*]  140+ floor and wall surface colors.
[/list]
🏺[b]Resizable Objects:[/b]
[list]
[*] Decorative, non-functional objects are resizable.
[/list]
🖌[b]Recolor Feature:[/b]
 [list]
[*] The colors of furniture and decor items are freely changeable.
[*] Save your favorite shades to your custom color palette!
[*] Use a tintable wallpaper!
[/list]
🪚[b]Room Dimension Flexibility:[/b]
[list]
[*] The height and width of rooms are resizable.
[/list]
📐[b]Freedom From the Grid:[/b]
[list]
[*]  Walls, fences, or roofs can be any size because the building process is not bound to the grid.
[*]  While the grid is turned off, you can freely arrange objects and place them quite close to each other on surfaces (tables, shelves, etc.).
[*]  Snapping and visual guides assist you when you don't have the support of the grid.
[*]  When the grid is activated, it guides the building process.
[/list]
🛠[b]Building Tools:[/b]
 [list]
[*] Foundations
[*]  Straight & Curved Wall Tool
[*]  Roofs
[*]  Resizeable Staircases
[*]  Fence tool
[*]  Path tool
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2606170

[i]Post your building screenshots on social media (Twitter, Instagram, or TikTok) using the #dreamhouse hashtag, or tag us for a chance to have your builds featured as a loading screen in the game (with credit to you as the author).[/i]

notes.title: DEVLOG 1. Build mode news
notes.content:
Hey, neighbors!

We have almost completed our build mode, so we can now share what new tools will be available in our game. You can also try them in Dream House soon! 


[b]What's new in the Build Mode [/b]🛠️🏡🎨

- Now you can save your favorite custom colors in the color wheel tool, and apply them to other furniture items.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42299119/837e6d653a909499d7e87d912f6ea4ed6a4885ae.gif[/img]
[b]New items have arrived[/b] 🚪🪑🪟🪞🛏

- Different styles of furniture items (Bohemian, Retro, Victorian, Antique, Cottagecore, Gothic, Modern, Minimalist, Industrial)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42299119/22e011b75d41ab9594fabcee8ae0ad2b1e09532d.png[/img]

[b]Other adjustments [/b] 🔍⚙️

- Change Time preview
- Camera view & lock
- Keyboard shortcuts
- Removal tool

Stay tuned as we'll soon take you more deeply behind the scenes to show off how our features work. 
[i]What do you want to know about first?[/i]🔍🛠️🪑

notes.title: Vivaland: Dream House
notes.content:
🏠 Great news for everyone who can't wait to play our game! 

Soon we are launching the Vivaland: Dream House prologue, where you can try out the game’s build mode either in single player mode or in co-op with your friends. Dream House will be entirely free to play!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42299119/330c74ca6e581ce70d5254af2f5a7c2f3316b0ac.gif[/img]
[h3]Here is what awaits you in this game:[/h3]

- Walls Toolkit
- Doors & Windows
- Foundations, Multiple Floors, and Stairs
- Furniture
- Roofing
- Resizable Objects
- Recolorable Furniture and Decor
- Room Dimension Flexibility
- Grid Function
- Intuitive Controls and Snapping

Don’t forget to wishlist it and stay tuned for our updates!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2606170/Vivaland_Dream_House/
